title: 105 次单位根 minimal vanishing sums：weight 20
confidence_basis: The exact classification was independently replayed from serialized input; destructive-input tests, second novelty search, citation audit, clean LaTeX build, metadata checks, and six-page visual PDF inspection all passed.
summary: Two weight-20 affine-Galois orbits were found. A no-import standard-library verifier reconstructed all 1,209,813 normalized vanishing subsets of weight at most 20 and certified that each contains one of exactly nine minimal affine orbits.
author: Zijian Zeng
affiliation: Institute of Computer Science and Digital Innovation, UCSI University, Kuala Lumpur, 56000, MALAYSIA
